verdict.rationale: ChatGPT's docs mention running multiple projects/tasks in parallel and applying feedback to one or more images at once, plus spreadsheet drafting that implies working across many rows, suggesting some multi-item automation depth. However there is no documented explicit 'bulk operations' feature (e.g., batch API, bulk file/record processing, mass edits) for the ChatGPT product itself. Missing for 10: an explicit bulk/batch operation feature, evidence of processing large item sets (hundreds/thousands) in one action, and independent confirmation of scale.
